summary: The support realization, original product normalization, all four asserted asymptotics, and the original containing-halfspace moment bound are proved without mathematical errors or gaps. The Boolean-midpoint enumeration correctly keeps pairs diagonal in one factor and removes only the global Boolean diagonal; the uniform factor makes the unequal-weight kernel factorization valid. Direct enumeration at the smallest high-block instance r=2, T=16 and the uniform-block parity count at m=16 agree with the formulas. The two uses of the accepted one-step moment theorem have precisely the required supports, tilts, and normalizations. The height-zero depth identification and product depth inequality include zero marginal normals, and their constants give exactly (1/32768) times 8^{-(k+1)}.
